description: Liven Pharma Limited manufactures pharmaceuticals and allied products at its plant on the Multan Road outside Lahore. It was incorporated as a private limited company in 1991 and converted to a public limited company in 1992.
sourceNote: Company website (liven-pharma.com: plant address and contact line) and the PSX company profile record, read 2026-10-17. The telephone number is published on the site as 111-0-LIVEN.
